label: Anti-GQ1b Antibody Syndrome: A Clinician-Oriented Perspective on Diagnostics, Therapy, and Atypical Phenotypes-With an Illustrative 16-Case Institutional Series.
summary: Anti-GQ1b antibody syndrome (AGABS) unifies triad-defined Miller Fisher syndrome (MFS), Bickerstaff brainstem encephalitis (BBE), and the ophthalmoplegic variant of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS-O) under a post-infectious immune mechanism centered on IgG to disialosyl gangliosides. The spectrum also encompasses triad-minus phenotypes-acute ophthalmoparesis without ataxia, acute vestibular syndrome, optic involvement, and acute sensory-ataxic neuropathy.
